beaches.name: Fyri Ammos (Kalamos)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported beyond the rocks north of the beach-bar entrance. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2016 to 2022; the 2022 report confirms the northern part is used nude even with the bar open. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Kombonada
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported on the southern part, away from the beach bar. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2017 and 2020 describing the southern stretch as nude; no designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Limni (Palaiopoli)
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix along the whole beach west of Palaiopoli. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2017, calling it established as clothing-optional, and from 2020, when it was entirely nude. No designation or signage is documented.
